topic.title: Turtle Shape and Color
topic.description: Customises a turtle by changing its shape and color before drawing. Introduces turtle appearance methods for more expressive graphics.

learningNotes.whatILearned: Using turtle.shape() to change cursor appearance and turtle.color() to set pen and fill color.
learningNotes.challenges: None — a short focused exploration of turtle appearance.
learningNotes.nextSteps: Combine shape and color changes with movement to draw colored shapes.

files.description: Turtle shape and color customisation demo.
